answer_1.quote: This paper also employs LLMs for EAE, but TISE is orthogonal to these works. We focus on how to select the optimal in-context example and our method is adaptable to various prompts.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are structured event argument extractions in the form of role-labeled entities, such as 'agent: (PER) "Iraq's minister"' and code imitation style generations like 'attack_event = Attack(attacker=[PER("forces")], place=[GPE("baghdad")], instrument=[WEA("weapons")])'.

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance with two metrics following previous work : Argument Identified (Arg-I) denotes the head word of an argument matches the human annotation, and Argument Classified (Arg-C) means an argument is correctly classified into its annotated role as well. We report them using F1 score.
